questions.q: Match each testing tool to what it is for.
pairs: Running a Streams topology without a broker
Testing code that sends records, including failed sends
Testing code that polls, with records and exceptions the test adds
Rewinding a Streams application's input topics and deleting its internal topics
questions.explain: TopologyTestDriver (in kafka-streams-test-utils) pipes records through a topology with no broker. MockProducer can complete sends one at a time or with an error (completeNext, errorNext); MockConsumer takes records with addRecord and failures with setPollException. The application reset tool resets input offsets and deletes internal topics, but not output topics or local state.

questions.q: Put the steps of a TopologyTestDriver test in order, first to last.
items: Build the Topology and create a TopologyTestDriver for it
Create a TestInputTopic and a TestOutputTopic with their serializers and deserializers
Pipe input records into the TestInputTopic
Read the output and assert on it
questions.explain: The driver simulates the runtime: createInputTopic gives a TestInputTopic for pipeInput, createOutputTopic a TestOutputTopic for readKeyValue or isEmpty. The docs say to call close() after each test.
